EO:6129.findings: No. 6129; dated May 11, 1933; Franklin D Roosevelt. Administration of the Emergency Conservation Work. Authorizing act March 31, 1933; supplements No. 6101 of April 5, 1933. Five complete paragraphs: (1) enrollment of 25,000 veterans of the World War as soon as possible, Director supervision and regulations; (2) practically same conditions as earlier enrollment; (3) separate organizational and distinctive enterprise part; (4) rapid enrollment and regular-program camp assignment; (5) actual enrollment not until full plans agreed on AND made public. Last clause is a condition, not proof it was met. One complete page incl footer number; adjacent sides are deposit-stamped without order text.

EO:6762.findings: No. 6762 signed Franklin D. Roosevelt., June 29, 1934. Withdrawal of Public Land for Lookout Station, California. Act June 25 1910 ch 421, 36 Stat. 847 as amended Aug 24 1912 ch 369, 37 Stat. 497. Subject to the conditions therein expressed AND to valid existing rights. Temporary withdrawal from settlement, location, sale, or entry for lookout-station purposes in connection with cooperative forest-protection work. Mount Diablo Meridian T. 33 N., R. 4 W., sec. 12, lot 16, 26.96 acres. Continues in full force and effect unless and until revoked by the President or by act of Congress. No such revocation is proved. Both adjacent images have stamps only.

EO:6910A.findings: No. 6910–A (suffix explicit); Franklin D Roosevelt, December 1, 1934. Purchase of Forest Lands for Emergency Conservation Work. Emergency Appropriation Act fiscal year 1935, approved June 19, 1934 (Title II, Public No. 412, 73d Congress). $899,675,000 appropriation versus $10,000,000 reallocation from Emergency Conservation Fund via Treasury to War. At request of Chief of Finance under direction of Director of Emergency Conservation Work, Treasury transfer to Agriculture, for withdrawal on requisition by Secretary of Agriculture; EO 6208 July 21 1933 and EO 6787 June 30 1934. p560 ends distinct EO 6910; 562 blank/stamp, 563 begins 6910–B. No appropriation performance or later disposition proved.
